title: 真实 CAN 完整 OTA 首次接线执行：A/B 对照排除固件，链路未建立
scope: bring-up only; no OTA traffic was attempted

environment.usb_can: PCAN-USB (VID_0C72:000C), Status OK, Present=True, 500 kbit/s, baud constant 0x1C
environment.stlink: STM32 STLink, Status OK, target voltage 2.87-2.88 V
environment.usb_232_ch340: all three historical instances Present=False; no real USB serial port; COM4/5/6/7/10/11 are Bluetooth virtual ports
environment.reference_voltage_1107: 3.24 V when the same link passed on 2026-11-07
environment.history: the 2.87 V value also appeared as the last reading before the probe lost contact during the 2026-11-05 idle power-cut experiment

measurements.result: PCAN-USB OK, STLink OK, CH340 absent
measurements.note: user reported all three cables connected; enumeration contradicts this for USB_232
SWD upload succeeded at 2.87 V target voltage

measurements.result: mass erase + download + verify + reset all passed
measurements.note: binary contains 'CAN: normal physical 500 kbit/s' and 'loader diagnostics: request 7E0, response 7E8'; no UART diagnostics strings -> correct CAN build

measurements.result: 50 frames, 0 UDS responses, 0 error frames, 10 echo frames per drain, CAN_GetStatus = 0x0
measurements.note: CAN_GetStatus 0x0 is NOT evidence of ACK on this clone adapter; it does not report ACK errors

measurements.result: 45 s, 9 requests at 5 s intervals, 0 responses, 0 error frames, final status 0x0
reflashed the exact 2026-11-07 passing image (sha256 8a3833885295f7cde4...) with mass erase + verify + reset; still 0 UDS responses
measurements.conclusion: firmware image, build variant, gating and PC scripts are ruled out

measurements.result: temporary probe firmware emitting 0x7E8 every 250 ms with runtime AFRH/BTR/MCR: 0 frames received
measurements.control: the identical probe technique received 18 frames in 8 s on 2026-11-07
measurements.conclusion: board is not acting as a CAN node in this session

measurements.result: RCC_CR=0x03007083 (PLL locked), bxCAN1 MCR=0x00010002 SLEEP=1, BTR=0x01230000 reset value, IER=0; SysTick VAL=0 twice; DHCSR=0x01010000
measurements.note: SWD hotplug snapshots were proven unreliable on 2026-11-07 (halt/reset artifact); recorded, NOT used as a conclusion

ruled_out: firmware image / build variant (A/B with the exact 2026-11-07 passing binary)
PCAN driver and PCANBasic API (CAN_Initialize=0x0, CAN_Write=0x0)
baud rate constant (0x1C verified correct; the 0x001C0000 bug from 2026-11-07 is not present)
UDS/ISO-TP PC client (same scripts that passed on 2026-11-07)
gating / NRC 0x72 (no response at all, not a negative response)
not_ruled_out: board 5 V rail / CAN transceiver power (NOT measured this session)
USB_232 physical connection (CH340 did not enumerate)
CANH/CANL/GND wiring after reconnect (not re-measured this session)
P5 jumper state (not visually re-confirmed this session)
leading_hypothesis: USB_232 is not actually connected, so the board has no 5 V feed for the CAN transceiver; ST-Link's 2.87 V target reading is consistent with weak/parasitic supply. This is an inference consistent with all measurements, NOT a measured root cause.
board_state_at_end: restored to the original 2026-11-07 read-only diagnostics image (sha256 8a383388...), mass erase + verify + reset passed
repo_state_at_end: both repositories clean; the two 2026-11-07 evidence JSONs that were temporarily overwritten by failing probes were restored to their committed passed versions
boundary: real CAN full OTA (0x34/0x36/0x37/0x31/0x11) is still UNVERIFIED. Nothing here may be written as passing.
